section1.title: Welcome to SakuraLands!
content: Play with friends from all over the world.
Join epic minigames, adventure and more!

section2.title: Multi Language!
content: Players from all over the world are welcome.
Our community supports multiple languages, so you’ll always find friends to play with.
section2.warning: * Some words are machine translated and may not be accurate.

section3.title: Many Minigames!
content: Enjoy a wide variety of minigames: parkour, skywars, bedwars, escape maze, and more.
There’s always something new to try!

section4.title: Safety!
content: We care about fair play and player security.
Our friendly staff team make sure your experience is safe and fun.
